profile: unique fresh Codex-Performance profile for every process
raw: every real process-frame finish as integer monotonic microseconds; effective settings/window markers; stdout/exit/context/source hashes
score: all frame finishes strictly inside the fixed window, grouped in ten complete one-second bins; exact total_frames * 1000000 / window_usec
zero: an observed complete zero-frame interval remains a measured zero and counts against the budget; no window/markers/samples is a distinct missing/invalid failure
gate: all predefined current-mode repeats valid and at least50; no omitted slow intervals/runs or retries to pick success
environment: same host/engine/settings/seed, serial measurements after heavy checks; record available host/power/load context without changing power settings
routes: retain actual original normal and F10 startup/autoplay routes; record location/player/camera and avoid attributing their difference solely to the overlay
profiling: if current F10 consistently below50, profile concrete existing cost; matched-route on/off diagnostic may separate route cost; preserve all attempts
mechanism_probe: record effective cap, wall time since startup and processed callbacks for original480 engine-frame command, without changing pacing
acceptance: full green CI and separate exact-SHA final review still required; card in_progress, PR draft, no merge
